content:
maria_cs: Heads up — inbound EUR wire hit our account tonight from ACME Solutions but remittance field is weirdly concatenated and maybe truncated. Bank shows ref: `PO#55678;INV:EC-442/7;VAT:DE` and then cuts off. No invoice attached in the payment message.

oliver_payments: Thanks Maria. Do we have the bank trace/UTR or value date? Need that to request MT103.

maria_cs: Value date 2024-11-06, amount €23,450. Trace 9876543210 (bank's trace id). No value in payer name — appears as "ACME TRADING LTD" but no customer ID.

sarah_finance: This is probably the PO + invoice + VAT all jammed into one field. If the VAT id is truncated we can't auto-match in our billing rules. Can we ask for the SWIFT MT103 and the remittance advice from the sending bank?

maria_cs: @oliver_payments could you ping the bank (via partner channel) for MT103? I can reach out to the customer for the invoice PDF but need bank proof to reconcile.

oliver_payments: On it. Filing request now — reference RP-2024-11-06-ACME. Bank-bot: `mt103_request_sent` (ticket 8812).

bank-bot: MT103 request acknowledged by treasury partner. ETA 24-48h. If urgent set priority with reason.

nate_eng: FYI — if we only have `PO#55678` we might still match against older invoices, but the truncation `INV:EC-442/7` -> could be `EC-442/71` or `EC-442/7A`. Matching rules are strict. We could add a fuzzy match fallback but that's product decision.

sarah_finance: For now we need manual hold release flow. Maria, please ask customer to reply with: invoice PDF, exact VAT ID, and the internal payment reference they used (if different from PO). Also ask them to confirm beneficiary name on their side.

maria_cs: Sending template now: "Hi — we received payment €23,450 on 6 Nov. Bank remittance shows truncated ref `PO#55678;INV:EC-442/7;VAT:DE`. To reconcile automatically we need: 1) invoice PDF, 2) full VAT number, 3) sending bank MT103 or payment confirmation. Can you send those?" Will cc @oliver_payments.

oliver_payments: Noted. Also adding manual mapping entry `ACME-55678-20241106` in ledger temp table so finance can post while we await proof. Sarah, confirm you want that temporary posting?

sarah_finance: Yes approve manual post to suspense GL with note linking to trace 9876543210 and ticket 8812. We'll reverse if proof differs.

maria_cs: Customer replied — they attached invoice `ACME_INV_EC-44271.pdf` and say VAT `DE123456789`. They claim their remittance field was `PO#55678|INV:EC-44271|VAT:DE123456789`.

nate_eng: That matches the hypothesized `EC-442/71` vs `EC-44271` drift. Good. Once MT103 arrives we'll confirm payer account and beneficiary fields.

bank-bot: MT103 available — uploaded to ticket 8812. Payment shows sender account XX12 3456 7890, ordering bank note: "PO#55678|INV:EC-44271|VAT:DE123456789" but our clearing partner truncated at semicolon during SWIFT -> SEPA transform.

oliver_payments: Got the MT103. Updating ticket. Finance, please reconcile: invoice `ACME_INV_EC-44271.pdf` matches amount and VAT. We can move from suspense GL to revenue and close ticket.

sarah_finance: Reconciled and closed. Added journal: debit bank €23,450, credit revenue €19,600, VAT payable €3,850. Note: set flag for rule-change request to tolerate pipe/semicolon variations in remittance parsing.

maria_cs: Closing thread. Action items: (1) payments to ask clearing partner about semicolon->truncation in SEPA transform, (2) product to consider fuzzy remittance parse rules, (3) CS to confirm customers now send MT103 copy when paying large invoices. :white_check_mark:
